# Watchfront

> Website monitoring software for agencies in India — uptime monitoring, SSL, forms, APIs, JS errors, SEO audits and client reports.

Watchfront helps agencies monitor client websites: uptime monitoring tool with downtime alerts, SSL certificate monitoring, domain expiry monitoring, contact form monitoring, API monitoring, JavaScript error monitoring, broken link checks, SEO audits, and white-label client website uptime reports.

Website: https://www.watchfront.in
Features: https://www.watchfront.in/features
Free tools: https://www.watchfront.in/tools
Guides: https://www.watchfront.in/guides
Contact: https://www.watchfront.in/contact
Start free: https://www.watchfront.in/register

## Free tools (no signup)

- [Website down checker](https://www.watchfront.in/tools/website-down-checker): check if a site is down for everyone, with HTTP status, response time and redirects
- [SSL certificate checker](https://www.watchfront.in/tools/ssl-checker): expiry date, days left, issuer, covered domains and browser trust
- [SEO checker](https://www.watchfront.in/tools/seo-checker): on-page SEO score 0-100 with a fix list

## Primary product pages

- [Uptime monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/features/uptime-monitoring): 1-minute checks, retries, confirmed-outage email alerts
- [SSL & domain expiry](https://www.watchfront.in/features/ssl-domain-monitoring): certificate and registry expiry warnings
- [SEO audit](https://www.watchfront.in/features/seo-audit): multi-page on-page SEO audits with scores and fix lists
- [Visual & content checks](https://www.watchfront.in/features/visual-regression-testing): missing text, broken links, screenshot baselines
- [Form & journey testing](https://www.watchfront.in/features/form-journey-testing): real-browser journeys for contact forms and bookings
- [API monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/features/api-monitoring): scheduled endpoint checks with assertions
- [JavaScript error monitoring](https://www.watchfront.in/features/javascript-error-monitoring): real-visitor errors grouped by fingerprint
- [Client reports](https://www.watchfront.in/features/client-reports): shareable uptime and incident reports
